blocks.html: This section is a race against time. Read it fully before continuing. You need to pass all challenges successfully in one go, otherwise you need to tell the clay golem to reset the levers so you can try again.

blocks.html: It is possible to empty the storage box of logs so you might need to bring your own in case you fail at first attempt. If you have a lower Firemaking level, you might not be able to stoke the furnace. For example, the storage box may give you magic logs, but if your Firemaking level is below 95, you won't be able to continue, unless you bring your own logs.
